tests.name: json_view_bool_to_int64
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<std::int64_t>() on a json_view boolean throws a type error instead of returning 0 or 1.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_uint64
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<std::uint64_t>() on a json_view boolean throws a type error.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_double
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<double>() on a json_view boolean throws a type error.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_int_succeeds
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<int>() on a json_view boolean successfully returns 1 instead of throwing.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_float_succeeds
tests.intent: Verify that calling get<float>() on a json_view boolean successfully returns 1.0 instead of throwing.

tests.name: basic_json_bool_to_int64_parity
tests.intent: Confirm basic_json get<std::int64_t>() on boolean throws type_error for behavioral parity check.

tests.name: json_view_get_to_int64
tests.intent: Verify that get_to() into a std::int64_t variable from a json_view boolean throws type_error.

tests.name: json_view_value_int64
tests.intent: Verify that view.value<std::int64_t>() on a boolean throws type_error.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_bool
tests.intent: Verify that view.get<bool>() works correctly on a boolean value.

tests.name: json_view_rejects_boolean_trait_check
tests.intent: Examine the visibility and behavior of rejects_boolean logic via template instantiation checks on arithmetic types.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_unsigned_long_long
tests.intent: Verify that get<unsigned long long>() (number_unsigned_t usually) throws on a json_view boolean.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_long_long
tests.intent: Verify that get<long long>() (number_integer_t usually) throws on a json_view boolean.

tests.name: json_view_number_float_actual
tests.intent: Verify that get<double>() on an actual floating point view succeeds without throwing.

tests.name: json_view_number_integer_actual
tests.intent: Verify that get<std::int64_t>() on an actual integer view succeeds without throwing.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_short
tests.intent: Verify that get<short>() on a json_view boolean succeeds and returns 1.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_char
tests.intent: Verify that get<char>() on a json_view boolean succeeds and returns non-zero.

tests.name: json_view_false_to_int
tests.intent: Verify that get<int>() on a json_view false boolean returns 0.

tests.name: json_view_false_to_int64
tests.intent: Verify that get<std::int64_t>() on a json_view false boolean throws type_error.

tests.name: json_view_bool_to_long_double
tests.intent: Verify that get<long double>() on a json_view boolean succeeds, since it is not number_float_t (double).

tests.name: json_view_multiple_gets_parity
tests.intent: Verify sequence of calls to get<int>() and get<std::int64_t>() demonstrating mixed behavior on the same boolean view.

tests.name: json_view_value_int64_fixed
tests.intent: Verify that view.value<std::int64_t>() on a boolean throws type_error.
